key_insight: The paper builds the first large spin-polarized electronic-structure database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing many compositionally tunable candidates for optoelectronic and magnetic applications.
engineering_relevance: It gives materials engineers a searchable dataset to screen double perovskites for visible-band-gap absorbers, half-metals, and bonding trends relevant to solar and multifunctional device design.
method: Spin-polarized DOS calculations across I, Br, Cl, and F chemistries
LOBSTER bonding analysis plus UMAP visualization and an interactive app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports >2,500 calculated compounds, including 719 visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metallic materials.
watch_item: The dataset is computational and stability-screened, so promising candidates still need experimental validation of phase stability, synthesis, and real-device performance.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
